title: Imports
entryIntro: Import KPI actuals from a CSV or XLSX file: rows are staged and validated first, and only valid rows are committed.
intro: Rows are staged and validated before anything is committed. Invalid and duplicate rows stay visible with their reasons.
formAlternative: Imports never depend on a connector. You can also enter each actual by form.
readOnly: You can view imports here but not upload or commit them.

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: Download a template prefilled with one row per active KPI you can see. Keep its header row.
templates.label: Label

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.intro: The file is checked and staged; nothing is committed until you commit the valid rows.
upload.fileHint: CSV (UTF-8) or XLSX, at most 10 MiB and 5,000 rows.

batches.title: Import batches
batches.emptyBody: Upload a file, or wait for a connector or webhook to stage one.

batch.title: Import batch
batch.stagedNotCommitted: Staged – not committed. Nothing from this file is in the KPI actuals until the valid rows are committed.
batch.stagingNote: Still staging: the counts are Unknown until it finishes.
batch.nothingToCommit: This import has no valid row to commit. Correct the file and upload it again, or cancel this import.
batch.commitIntro: {{valid}} valid rows will be committed. Invalid and duplicate rows stay visible and uncommitted.
batch.commitPath: Each row goes through the KPI actual submission, exactly like the form: it is submitted, never accepted directly.
batch.noteTooShort: Enter at least 3 characters, or leave it empty.
batch.cancelBody: Nothing is committed. The staged rows are kept for the record.
